title: Comrades Marathon 2026 Final Race Instructions
claims: A total of 49 official, fully stocked refreshment stations were positioned along the 2026 route; all stations offered water sachets, Thirsti Sport energy drinks and Coca-Cola, and selected stations also offered potatoes, orange segments, bananas, 32Gi supplements and Orange Grove Amahewu.

Supporters could provide refreshments or supplies to non-elite participants from a stationary position alongside the route; mobile seconding was prohibited, as was parking on freeways or restricted roads, and no supporter or second could drive, cycle or run alongside a participant within 100 metres of a refreshment station.

Participants had to move forward under their own power; anyone carried or physically supported on the route or across the finish line would be stopped, referred for medical attention and subjected to disciplinary procedures.

The 2026 event used a Traffic Light Cut-off System with six intermediate cut-off points at 18.5 km (Pinetown Underpass), 29.5 km, 43.0 km, 56.9 km, 67.0 km and 79.1 km, plus the finish; all cut-off times were calculated from the final Group 3 start at 05:30, and the finish cut-off was 12 hours.
The 2026 race started in three groups at 05:00, 05:15 and 05:30, with wheelchair participants starting at 04:45.
The official race distance for the 2026 Comrades Marathon was 85.777 km.

The race route was closed to all non-accredited vehicles, bicycles and other individual transport; no driving, cycling or parking was permitted along the route, and certain access roads were closed as dedicated emergency-vehicle escape routes.
The 2026 race started outside the Durban City Hall and finished inside the Hollywoodbets Scottsville Racecourse in Pietermaritzburg.
Late starters were accepted only up to 15 minutes after the Group 3 start, i.e. until 05:45, after which the start timing mats were removed.

The official route map was published on the Comrades Marathon website, the official app and the digital souvenir magazine; the instructions did not provide a downloadable GPX file or a track-reuse licence.

Dedicated elite refreshment stations allowed seeded athletes to collect pre-mixed drinks and race nutrition; unauthorised removal of or interference with elite supplies could lead to sanctions and exclusion from future races.

Official rescue buses operated at designated cut-off points and along the route to carry retiring or cut-off runners to the finish area; boarding a rescue bus recorded the race number and marked the runner as a DNF, with no re-entry.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 2026 Final Race Instructions PDF 全文。关门表 OCR 有明显错字，正文只安全引用 Pinetown Underpass 18.5 km、其余里程数字与 12 小时终点，不照抄 OCR 地名。
